================================================================================
Neo4j: a relationship with no direction is not a comment
================================================================================

MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.name AS person, count{(p)--()} AS degree LIMIT 2;
MATCH (m:Movie) RETURN m.title;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement
    (variable
      (variable_name)))
  (statement
    (variable
      (variable_name))))

================================================================================
Neo4j: a path of relationships with no direction
================================================================================

MATCH (a)--(b)--(c) RETURN a;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement))

================================================================================
Neo4j: relationships with a direction
================================================================================

MATCH (a)-->(b) RETURN a;
MATCH (a)<--(b) RETURN a;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement)
  (statement))

================================================================================
Neo4j: two minus signs are text
================================================================================

RETURN 5--3;
-- a; b

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement)
  (statement)
  (statement))

================================================================================
Neo4j: slash comments and block comments
================================================================================

MATCH (n) // a comment; with a semicolon
RETURN n /* b; */;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement
    (comment)
    (comment)))
